enchantment.masks-n-glory.fear.desc: Blinds both you and your target with with hyperventilation
enchantment.masks-n-glory.discombobulate: Makes the opponent slower on hit
enchantment.masks-n-glory.lethal.desc: Makes the opponent nauseous on hit
enchantment.masks-n-glory.serial.desc: Deals more damage and heals you with each hit you land scaling on how long a combo has been going on for.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.skull.desc: damage scales with how many blocks you've fallen.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.death.desc: If the opponent is under 5 hearts, you can catch them 'using' an item to execute them.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.combo.desc: Quickly attack your opponent, if you manage to kill them in the same combo, all the hits you've landed will be turned into absorption for you.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.antiseptic.des: Immune to most poison, and bad statues effects when holding the knife
enchantment.masks-n-glory.soul.desc: empower your hits a hunger effect
enchantment.masks-n-glory.ret.desc: Trade your flashbang for a row of fangs exactly like an evoker
enchantment.masks-n-glory.undead.desc: summon 4 vexes to aid you in combat for 15 seconds, be aware however, Evocation is a dangerous magic. Guess who they'll attack, if there's nobody but you around.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.homing.desc: the sword locks onto the last thing you hit, and applies 'pinning' when it lands.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.remorse.desc: the sword sticks into whoever you hit, right click to yank it back, sneak right click to go to it instead. it comes back on its own after 30 seconds if you forget about it.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.stunt_double.d: apply the 'stunt double' effect to you and people nearby, this effect nullify totems completely.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.afterlife.desc: gather souls on death, can be shot at opponent.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.risk.desc: applies the 'rotting' effect on opponent, hiding their health bar completely.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.lockout.desc: every 5 hits, the target's joints seize up on them.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.pact.desc: every piece of armor you leave off makes your hits land harder.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.temper.desc: Wind up your attack and land a devastating blow, don't miss or it resets.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.incumbent.desc: damage scales with how long a fight has been going on for.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.notoriety.desc: For every individual player you kill, you will gain a small damage boost. (reset on death).
enchantment.masks-n-glory.cast_iron.desc: right click to hold the pan up like a shield, every hit it eats charges it up, and once it's full it lets out a shockwave that throws everyone off you.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.grease.desc: coats whoever you hit in grease, they'll slide around uncontrollably for 5 seconds. sneak right click to coat yourself
enchantment.masks-n-glory.artillery.desc: use the pickaxe like a crossbow to fire shears. they get pulled toward lightning rods, and cause bleeding on hit.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.plummet.desc: the further the target has fallen, the harder you hit them, and the further they go flying.
enchantment.masks-n-glory.surge.desc: right click again after you throw the sword to give it a boost mid-air.
